Q: ta.highest doesn't work inside conditional A:

he warning message you should NOT be ignoring already tells you what the issue is and how to fix it.

ta.highest should be called on each calculation for consistency. It is recommended to e4xtract the call from this scope.

Functions like ta.highest() must run on every bar. If you put them inside an if block, they skip bars and give unreliable results.

Try something like below:

int len = math.max(nz(RdX1dX2), 1)
float highestPrev = ta.highest(high[1], len)
High_max := JestCrossDown != 0 and RdX1dX2 > 0 ? highestPrev : na

This will have a consistent history and only update High_max when JestCrossDown != 0 is true just like in your original logic.
